name: mm-drive
description: Autonomous outer drive: dual-critic APPROVE + oya-ci-required green => merge. Human supervises only. Soft reds/blocks MUST enter task board via mm-queue-ingest — never silent.
process_fix_definition: Edit harness/workflows/tools so agents cannot repeat the mistake class. Not one-off rebases, chat memory, or symptom-only patches. Canonical: programs/hyperscaler-delivery-lanes/BUN-PARALLEL-DISCIPLINE.md

stop_hook.note: waiting_ci may allow Stop only when a re-poll monitor/scheduler is armed or next re-tick is explicit. Never treat waiting_ci as idle_complete. If resolvable or merge_ready exists, always block Stop.

push_budget.note: F-CI-PUSH-THRASH: prefer armed re-poll over cancelling oya-ci-required; batch dual-critic evidence with the next CI-fix push when possible

kit_presence.note: F-WORKTREE-MISSING-KIT / F-KIT-NOT-ON-DEV: no multi-model claim without kit on tree; land kit on origin/dev

merge_policy.note: FULL AUTONOMY under human supervision: dual-critic APPROVE + oya-ci-required SUCCESS => mm-drive merge. No human GH APPROVE required. Non-APPROVE => fix until APPROVE. Soft reds MUST be on task board (mm-queue-ingest); do not treat soft failure as ignore. Self-approve GH never counts. CI-infra needs preflight receipt. After merge: tip-sync + R3 packet.

classes.resolvable: CI red, soft red on board, dual-critic non-APPROVE, merge blocks, open ready lanes — block Stop and continue
classes.waiting_ci: Checks pending after push — allow Stop ONLY if a re-poll monitor/scheduler is armed or an explicit re-tick time is recorded; never treat as idle_complete; on next turn re-query gh and tip-sync if base advanced
classes.human_blocked: Secrets/founder ratify only — NOT dual-critic wait. Missing dual-critic APPROVE is resolvable (fix until APPROVE), not human_blocked.
classes.merge_ready: Agent dual-critic APPROVE (admit verdicts) + oya-ci-required SUCCESS + merge-check ok — autonomous squash-merge; human GH APPROVE not required
classes.idle_complete: Terminal evidence recorded for that story — allow Stop (not the same as waiting_ci)
classes.sequenced_blocked: Gated on another story (e.g. W0-B after G001) — allow Stop
classes.unknown: Could not re-query — allow Stop fail-soft

soft_red_policy.clear_when: check no longer FAILURE/ERROR on tip OR explicit waiver lane status=waived with reason
soft_red_policy.note: Soft legs continue-on-error in GHA but process still queues them; implement/babysit must drain.
